easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Naga Fleshcrafter enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Naga Fleshcrafter from the battlefield to your hand.
When Naga Fleshcrafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Naga Fleshcrafter from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.
